description: How to buy a Kantrom Agent Credential (1 USDC via x402, valid 1 year): a verifiable, revocable credential signed by did:web:kantrom.com attesting the wallet that pays and, optionally, a domain you control (DNS TXT) with a name. Returns the steps and exact payment requirements.

dominio.description: optional domain you control, e.g. example.com

wallet.description: wallet you will pay from (needed with dominio)
